# Sunflower Cleaners

> Family-owned dry cleaners in Henderson, Nevada, run by the same husband and wife since 2004. Dry cleaning, laundry, and in-house alterations, with all work done on premises. Specialty services most cleaners no longer offer: wedding gown cleaning and preservation, leather and suede, and hat cleaning.

## The essentials

- Website: https://sunflower-cleaners-lewbimsm-rgbs-projects.vercel.app/
- Address: 50 N Valle Verde Dr, Suite 120, Henderson, NV 89074 (in front of Kohl's, just off the 215; free parking)
- Phone: (702) 251-0888
- Hours: Monday-Friday 7:00 AM - 6:30 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM, closed Sunday and major holidays
- Turnaround: most items ready in 2-3 days
- Payment: cash, all major cards, tap to pay including Apple Pay; payment at drop-off
- Service is in-store only (no pickup or delivery)
- Rated 4.3 stars by customers on Google

## Services

- Dry cleaning (suits, dresses, coats, delicates) - cleaned on our own machines on site
- Laundered and pressed shirts
- Alterations and tailoring - done in-house, each job quoted at the counter before work begins
- Wedding gowns - cleaning and preservation (a specialty)
- Leather and suede (a specialty)
- Hats - cleaned and shaped (a specialty)
- Comforters and bedding
- Press only
- Household items (table linens, cushion covers, drapes)

## Who we serve

Neighbors in Henderson: Green Valley, Seven Hills, Anthem, and Inspirada, plus customers who drive from Summerlin.
